summary: Diseñé y reabrí desde main un benchmark sintético 15× listo para compilación mecánica a generic RUN packet: 5 variantes de prompting × 3 réplicas, asignación fija intercalada y fresh worker por slot. La carga común tiene 72 subtareas locales en seis bloques (~3500–5500 palabras útiles), un único MIDPOINT durable tras B3, cero I/O externo permitido dentro de las ventanas locales salvo esa escritura/receipts, y una reallocation posterior de 30 subtareas en el mismo worker antes de CLOSE. Clocks primarios provienen de eventos/commits externos; false-zero, calidad, taxonomía de fallas, contaminación y autoridad sintética están explicitados. Cada tratamiento cambia un único delta de prompting frente al control.

tests.detail: 5 variants, 15 unique slots, exactly 3 replicas per variant.
Control has no prompt delta; each treatment owns one causal_delta_key/prompt_delta and inherits the same common contract.
6 blocks × 12 heterogeneous subtasks = 72 primary local tasks; per-task and block-summary word targets imply ~3500–5500 useful words.
Exactly one durable MIDPOINT is specified after B3/36 tasks; B3 cannot terminate primary work.
No web/GitHub/tools/external I/O after capsule load until MIDPOINT, nor MIDPOINT→primary receipt, nor during post-primary local reallocation.
Same worker/nonce must complete 30 additional synthetic tasks after primary receipt before CLOSE, with no human recap.
Claim/MIDPOINT/primary/reallocation/close clocks are external durable events; model clocks are diagnostic; numeric zero requires closed coverage.
Independent verifier, DONE≠PASS, quality gates, 27 failure classes and contamination rules are explicit.
Slots, common capsule, per-slot prompt delta, immutable hashes and stage expectations map mechanically to a future generic RUN packet.
Synthetic output is EXPERIMENT_ONLY_NOT_PRODUCT_VALUE and cannot promote Current/Human Accepted/Served/WORKER_PIPELINE.
